notes: Designer decision (Oct 2026), replacing the book's minor/major split (STA 2e Quickstart p. 23-24): every combatant (party and enemies) starts each turn with actionPoints AP; each action costs apCost. Any action except Move may be repeated in a turn (e.g. Attack + Attack). First pass implements Move, Aim, Attack and End Turn.
Designer decision (Oct 2026): Move is once per turn and goes up to the character's full movement allowance (Fitness-based); unused tiles are lost.
Designer decision (Oct 2026): at 0 AP the turn ends by itself (to the next party member with AP, else onward). End Turn (free) ends a turn with AP left.
Designer decision (Oct 2026), following the book (STA 2e Quickstart p. 22): there is no Take Cover action. A unit next to a cover object is in cover automatically (removed from the mockup's panel).
panel: the actions shown in the Actions panel, in mockup order. The others are defined for later passes.

Designer decision (Oct 2026): Attack and Aim are not in the panel. Clicking an enemy shows buttons around it: Stun and Deadly (fire at once), Aim, Use Item and Info. Clicking a party member shows Assist (and Switch, to hand them the turn).

actions.name: Move
actions.description: Once per turn: walk up to your full movement. End next to a cover object to be in cover.

actions.name: Aim
actions.description: Reroll one die on your next attack this turn.

actions.name: Assist
actions.description: Pick an ally who still has a turn this round. Their next attack adds your 1d20; its success counts if they score at least one.
